room-101.summary: Trip hazard identified in primary bed path.
room-101.details: The floor cable from the telemetry monitor crosses the walking path between the bed rail and patient room door.
room-101.recommendation: Secure power line using hospital-grade rubber cable bridge or route along perimeter baseboard clip.

room-102.details: The bed-to-door path is clear, bedside equipment is positioned safely, and required care access points remain unobstructed.
room-102.recommendation: Maintain current equipment placement and continue routine visual checks.
